subject: science
passage: Sea otters along the Pacific coast of North America eat large amounts of hard-shelled prey such as clams, mussels, and snails. Many otters crack these shells by floating on their backs, placing a flat rock on their chests, and pounding the prey against it. Not every otter uses tools equally, however. Researchers in California have found that females are more likely than males to use rocks, and that tool users can eat harder prey while suffering less damage to their teeth. Tool use, it appears, helps otters make the most of foods that would otherwise be difficult to eat.
stem: Which choice best states the main purpose of the text?

choices.A: To describe a sea otter behavior and explain how it benefits the otters that use it
choices.B: To explain why sea otters prefer hard-shelled prey to all other kinds of food
choices.C: To argue that tool use is the main reason sea otters survive along the Pacific coast
choices.D: To report that female sea otters use rocks as tools more often than males do

explanation.why: The text first describes how otters use rocks to open shells, then reports what researchers found about which otters use tools and how it helps them. The last sentence sums up the point: tool use "helps otters make the most of foods that would otherwise be difficult to eat." The text describes a behavior and explains its benefit.
explanation.A: Correct. The text describes otters cracking shells with rocks and explains that tool users can eat harder prey with less damage to their teeth.
explanation.B: Incorrect. The text says otters eat hard-shelled prey but never says they prefer it to other foods or explains such a preference.
explanation.C: Incorrect. The text says tool use helps otters eat difficult foods; it never claims tool use explains the species' survival.
explanation.D: Incorrect. This finding is mentioned, but it is only one detail in a text about how and why otters use tools.
